description: This PHP source file defines the class BigPipeResponseAttachmentsProcessor, which extends HtmlResponseAttachmentsProcessor to handle processing of attachments in HTML responses with BigPipe enabled in Drupal. It includes methods for constructing the processor and processing attachments, particularly managing BigPipe placeholders.

classes.name: BigPipeResponseAttachmentsProcessor
classes.description: A class extending HtmlResponseAttachmentsProcessor to handle BigPipe-specific attachment processing in Drupal responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the processor with dependencies such as response processor, asset resolver, config factory, asset collection renderers, request stack, renderer, module handler, and language manager.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Processes the attachments of an HTML response, managing BigPipe placeholders and delegating other processing to the parent processor.
